items.difficulty_reason: Colimits, tensor products and internal Homs in QCoh(O_X) computed in Mod and staying quasi-coherent (also for finite locally free): the proof fixes an object x over U, notes it suffices to test quasi-coherence of the restriction to (Sch/U)_tau by the two characterisation lemmas, uses that the slice site is a localisation so restriction commutes with colimits/tensor/Hom (three Modules on Sites lemmas), and reduces to Descent, qc-colimits. Retained author proof at lines 2141-2158.
